skillset.skill: 13s CT - 3000% Fire DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30.
skillset.arts: For 25s, allies gain a DMG barrier that negates 8000 DMG, increase allies' DMG RES by 20% and Human allies' MAX HP by 20%.
skillset.protagonize: Can be activated instead of Arts - Increase the final DMG dealt to enemies by 1.3x, and halves allies' Break Power and HP Recovery Amount.
skillset.truearts: 65000% Fire DMG (PHY). For 35s, increase own Equip CT Speed by [40 + 10 x # of Fire allies]% (MAX: 80%).
skillset.superarts: 250000% Fire DMG (PHY). Increase own CRI rate by 100% for the duration of own Super Arts. Increase own Super CRI rate by 100% against enemies under 50% HP for the duration of own Super Arts.

passive.ability1: When above 80% HP, increase own Equip DMG by 100%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Rudo's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Rudo's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.skill: 55s CT - 4000% Fire DMG (PHY). For 30s, increase own PHY DMG by 30% (stackable) and reduce enemies' Fire RES by 20% (stackable).
